name: interactive-hover-button

frames.best_why: The dot has flooded the pill pale and the second label is in place, the hover state at rest.

tagline: A dot swells to fill the pill on hover as the label slides out for an arrow.
summary: A rounded button whose small dot grows to flood the whole pill when hovered. The resting label drifts away and a second copy with a right arrow slides in.
appearance: Inside a dark card sit a tiny outlined badge, a bold heading and a line of grey copy, with a pill button at the bottom. The button has a thin border, a small round dot at its left and white text; hovered, the pill turns pale and the text dark.
behaviour: On hover the dot scales up to cover the button over a third of a second while the first label slides right and fades and a second label with a right arrow slides in. Leaving the button runs the same transition back.
demo_content: Badge "New in v2.4", heading "Ship interfaces faster", explanatory copy and a button labelled Get started
search_phrases: dot grows to fill the button on hover
label slides away and an arrow appears
pill button with a sweeping fill
call to action that swaps text on hover
button with a growing circle behind text
hover animation for a get started button
text swap on hover with arrow
small dot expanding into a filled pill
use_when: A primary call to action wants a moment of motion without changing its size or the layout.
avoid_when: Touch-first layouts, where hover never fires, and labels people need to keep reading while they aim.
customise: The label is children and is rendered twice, once at rest and once with the arrow on hover; colours follow theme tokens, while size and radius come from className.
weight_why: Two short CSS transitions on a scale and a translate, idle when not hovered.

a11y.note: The arrow label only appears on hover, so keyboard and touch users never see the finished state.

issues: The hovered label sits grey on a pale pill, noticeably weaker contrast than at rest.
polish_why: Crisp motion and clear hierarchy; the hovered label's contrast is the weak point.
title: Interactive Hover Button
